entry.summary:
What does it mean to create a ripple effect in mental health? In this video, we explore the vital role of Forensic Psychiatrists in New Zealand and the positive change they bring to some of our most complex cases. 

Whether you are looking for a new professional challenge or a better lifestyle in New Zealand, see why our clinicians find their work so impactful.

Thinking of a move to NZ? Visit our careers page to learn more about joining our teams ➡️ HealthNZ.govt.nz/Forensic-Psychiatrists
